notes.hook: The historical irony of minting medals for a victory that never happened is a compelling hook.
notes.clarity: The sequence from the hubris of the medals to the specific details of the defeat is easy to follow.
notes.payoff: The devastating reality of 9,000 deaths contrasted with the celebratory coins provides a strong payoff.
notes.visuals: All frames are historically accurate and clearly depict the people and events mentioned.
notes.loop: Ending and beginning with the same phrase creates a smooth and satisfying narrative circle.

rounds.better_than_last: This short improves on the payoff of episode 53 by creating a more poignant contrast between British hubris and the actual tragedy.
